verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime is a banking-as-a-service API platform, and whether a SaaS product publishes source under an open license is a fair axis to judge. Nothing in the evidence mentions open-source code, a public repository, or a license. The materials cover only a hosted API, a sandbox, a Postman collection and llms.txt docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
